common_rules: Every comparison cell is explicitly a project reconstruction; original attribution claims remain separately addressable in dependency_map.source_anchors/claim nodes.

Six ontological families are not the four moral-grounding families. Moral naturalism has Railton original representation; constructivist/rational and non-natural realist positive originals remain missing.
No total-order ranking or numeric posterior is performed. Equal open labels are not equal credibility.
A basic entity/law may be an explanatory stopping point in any family; count independent adjustable properties and rules symmetrically.
